name: FSR 584 (Hubble)
blurb: FSR 584, a heavily obscured old star cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: fsr584-hubble
story: Veiled by thick dust in the direction of the molecular cloud W3, FSR 584 is an old star cluster that may be a newly recognized globular cluster of the Milky Way. Hubble looked in infrared light to pin down its age and nature.

claims.text: FSR 584 is an old star cluster, possibly a new Milky Way globular cluster
It is projected toward the molecular cloud W 3
It is heavily obscured by dust
Program 17918 targets FSR2007-0584 to estimate age and nature of obscured globular clusters
